    return result

def intersection(a, b):
    return sorted(list(set(a) & set(b)))

def is_sorted(values):
    return all(values[i] <= values[i + 1] for i in range(len(values) - 1))

def strip_punctuation(text):
    return ''.join([char for char in text if char.isalnum()])

def hamming(a, b):
    return sum(1 for x in zip(a, b) if x[0] != x[1])

def frequency(values):
    return {value: values.count(value) for value in values}

def diagonal_sum(rows):
    return sum(row[i] for row in rows for i in range(len(row))) if rows else 0

def camel_to_snake(text):
    return '_' + text[0].lower() + '_' + text[1:].lower() if text else ''

def even_values(values):
    return [num for num in values if num % 2 == 0]

def ceil_div(a, b):
    return a / b if b > 0 else 0

def is_power_of_two(n):
    return n > 0 and (n & (n - 1)) == 0
